requirements.requirement: Reusable Setting Definition, Campaign instance, reveal state and provenance remain distinct semantic layers.
Source fact, source-unspecified, conflict/revision, proposal, accepted authored fact and Campaign-local state remain distinguishable.
Unknown geography, parentage, chronology, connectivity, compatibility and mechanics remain unknown rather than receiving defaults.
Typed hierarchy supports worlds, realms, branches, planes, layers, cities, stations, ships, routes, zones, districts and other source-supported setting entities without planet-only assumptions.
Hierarchy, membership and cosmology placement require explicit source evidence or governed authoring provenance; co-occurrence/name/theme/proximity cannot create relations.
The Havalaea → Vertigon relation is attributable to explicit reciprocal source evidence and cannot be generalized into unsupported neighboring hierarchy.
Reusable environment templates remain distinct from setting-attached environment profiles and never instantiate named settings automatically.
Environment attachment preserves template provenance and explicit setting scope and does not rewrite the reusable template.
Campaign-local environment mutation remains PPIA-08-owned and cannot rewrite PPIA-12 reusable Setting Definitions or templates.
Settlements, infrastructure and landmarks remain typed setting structures with explicit placement provenance.
Generic Items or Vehicles do not become setting infrastructure or ownership relations solely from document proximity or mention.
Hidden landmarks, portals and hubs are filtered before maps, counts, pathfinding, summaries and AI context.
Faction, institution and governance facts remain distinct from location identity and use explicit jurisdiction/presence relations.
Faction co-occurrence does not create location parentage, ownership or jurisdiction without explicit evidence.
Current Campaign faction metrics/control remain Campaign-local and do not rewrite reusable governance facts.
Culture, society, religion, language, calendar, customs and economy remain typed setting-scoped facets.
Setting culture and society do not become Species biology or immutable Character traits through co-occurrence.
Mixed source facets such as The Empire remain separately typed rather than flattened into one World identity record.
Historical events, eras, chronology and causal relations require source evidence or explicit governed authoring decisions.
Document order, paragraph order, file naming and co-occurrence do not create chronology.
Stratebrait-style older/current/new conflicts remain separately attributable until governed resolution and never silently rewrite raw source.
World-local availability, membership and variant/extension metadata preserve stable owning-object references and setting scope.
PPIA-02/03/04/05 and Ability/rules owners retain core Definitions; PPIA-12 does not silently fork or overwrite mechanics.
Setting-source co-occurrence with an object does not automatically prove membership, availability, ownership, variant identity or compatibility.
World-local and branch-local mechanics retain explicit setting scope and provenance.
Musical Reality, branch-specific and unusual-local-physics mechanics are not automatically promoted to universal/core rules.
Broader rule promotion requires separate owning-domain authority, provenance and validation outside PPIA-12 setting-scope authoring.
Routes, portals and connectivity remain distinct from containment hierarchy and require typed endpoints and explicit evidence.
Shared multiversal context, organizations, theme or proximity do not imply route connectivity.
Route access, discovery and pathfinding are permission-filtered before traversal results and have semantic non-map equivalents.
PPIA-08 Campaign/Scene instantiation stores stable reusable Setting Definition references rather than copying or mutating source Definitions.
Campaign destruction, occupation, renaming, discovery, current control and timeline state mutate only the Campaign instance.
Campaign-local mutations use expected-version and idempotency/recovery controls and do not affect other Campaigns.
Authorization/filtering precede hidden settings, locations, routes, factions, history, secrets, counts, maps, summaries, exports, diagnostics, notifications, pathfinding and AI context.
Unauthorized errors, route validation and aggregate differences cannot disclose hidden fact existence.
Assistant GM and service/AI roles receive minimum delegated projections and cannot independently author, reveal, resolve source conflicts or promote local mechanics.
Worldbuilding guidance, random tables, templates and AI assistance produce attributed proposals rather than automatic canonical facts.
Proposal acceptance routes through the specific owning authoring workflow and does not inherit acceptance authority from generation.
Rejected, abandoned or unresolved proposals leave existing reusable Definitions and raw source unchanged.
Every authoritative PPIA-12 mutation is expected-version checked and idempotent or governed by an equivalent concurrency contract.
Ambiguous network outcomes query operation status with the original operation ID before retry and reuse the same idempotency identity.
Reconnect reauthorizes role, Campaign/authoring scope, visible secrets and versions; broad offline authoritative World/Setting mutation is forbidden.
All required World/Setting workflows support keyboard, touch, screen-reader and high-zoom/reflow operation.
Hierarchy, routes, environments, reveal state, local-rule scope and source/conflict state have semantic textual/nonvisual equivalents.
No required workflow depends solely on map geometry, color, drag, hover, animation or visual node placement; maps remain supplemental.
Source coordinates, conflict/revision assertions, authored decisions, operation history and recovery receipts remain attributable and exportable within permission scope.
PPIA-12 routes rather than absorbs PPIA-08 Campaign/Scene state, PPIA-02/03/04/05 object Definitions, Ability/rules promotion, PPIA-11 balance, F020/F021 recovery/privacy and F022 accessibility.
Completion does not activate STAGE-A-A2, mutate application runtime, universalize setting-local content/rules, or authorize release/deployment/tester/paid/credential operations.
